Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class Message

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.Message
public final class Message extends Object
One entry in a ChatThread (ADR-0005). A single final class with a private constructor and named factories, so a message can never be built in an invalid shape.

There are exactly two shapes: text(String, User) carries user-authored text and no request link, while formalOffer(User, DealRequest) carries a linked request and a generated summary instead of user text. Because the offer factory has no content parameter, a mixed text-and-offer message is unconstructible.

  • Method Details

    • text

      public static Message text(String content, User sender)
      Creates a free-text message. Empty or blank content is rejected.

    • formalOffer

      public static Message formalOffer(User sender, DealRequest request)
      Creates a Formal Offer from request. There is deliberately no content parameter: the stored content is a generated summary of the request's terms (used for keyword search and card labelling), never user-authored text. The summary omits the request status, because status changes after the offer is made.

    • restore

      public static Message restore(String content, LocalDateTime sentTime, User sender, DealRequest dealRequest)
      Rebuilds a saved message exactly as stored: its original time and, for a Formal Offer, the stored summary and the restored request. Only for loading the database.
